p: Islington is one of London's best spots for a night out that mixes culture and fun. Sadler's Wells, a short walk from Angel, is a renowned dance theatre, with performances ranging from ballet to contemporary dance. Union Chapel on Compton Terrace is a working church that doubles as a beautiful live music venue, and catching a gig there is something special. Pair either with a darts session and you've got a cracking evening.

If you'd rather be outdoors, the Regent's Canal towpath is a peaceful walk, with narrowboats and leafy stretches between Islington and Camden or east towards Victoria Park. Highbury Fields, at the northern end of Upper Street, is a big green space for a stroll or a picnic.

For the darts, a few tips. Book for the right number of players and get there a little early to settle in with a drink. If your group's on the larger side, split into teams across two oches. Start with a simple game before moving on to the luck-based formats, which are great for keeping things close.

Never thrown a dart? Stand side-on to the board, keep your elbow steady and use your forearm to throw. A smooth release and a gentle follow-through usually work better than trying to throw hard. The scoring tech keeps track of everything, so all you need to do is aim and enjoy the friendly rivalry. Upper Street's restaurants will be waiting when you're done, whoever ends up buying dinner.
